hold_implementation_diagnosis.evidence_schema_note: rows, row_count, last_row, row_120, counter resets and remaining first-sweep count derive only from rows_snapshot. Generic snapshot_file/source/sha256 are aliases of rows_snapshot. native_buffered_snapshot is separate evidence.
hold_implementation_diagnosis.global_buffer_budget_policy: Fixed floor(0.4 * initial OpenDB instance count) for the entire selected batch; before and after every native call actual instance growth is checked. Exhaustion skips later targets. Overrun rejects the isolated candidate even if native calls report success or throw.

model_findings: QSPI SCK, IO data, output enable and chip-select all use the same clk_i-referenced max+3/min-4 budget. SCK is itself a generated forwarded clock, while OE is a pad-control signal, so these are not identical external timing relationships.

In steady transfers RTL changes IO data/OE on falling SCK events and flash model samples on rising SCK. DIV=0 still leaves one full core period (20ns) between those SCK events. Start/stop, pause and abort are additional cases and prevent blindly applying a single multicycle exception.

The 2ns board/pad allowance is explicitly assumed, not measured. A correct replacement contract needs separate minimum/maximum SCK and data flight delays, pad enable/disable times, flash setup/hold, chip-select timing and read-turnaround constraints. Preserve existing constraints until that model is independently validated.
native_repair_findings: RepairHold.cc393-445 tests max_iterations/max_passes only around an entire repairHoldPass, not before every endpoint.

RepairHold.cc503-530 sorts failing endpoints once and processes all of them while incrementing pass; only maximum buffer count breaks this inner scan. 4073 endpoints are below hold_margin=0.15, including non-negative endpoints.
Once the first QSPI endpoints were attempted, the unchanged worst endpoint label during later iterations does not mean QSPI was retried on every iteration. The tool is visiting remaining endpoints.
Buffer counter reductions can be journal restore resetting inserted_buffer_count_ to0 (RepairHold.cc652-656); counter alone is not total netlist buffer growth.

A QSPI-local guarded attempt can fail due to setup headroom, global setup deterioration or a>20% slew increase. Current progress-only logs cannot distinguish these causes; dedicated endpoint timing/debug is needed.

qspi_constraint_audit.rtl_recommendation: Do not add an extra data/OE register, asynchronous synchronizer, behavioral #delay, or use only a larger DIV setting as a hold fix. Those either change protocol latency, are not synthesizable physical delays, or do not change this same-edge SDC hold check. Retime the whole interface only with updated cycle contracts/formal tests if a branch-only physical ECO cannot close it.
